direction: Wooden HUD, controls, buttons and menus; a game adaptation, not an asserted 1893 artifact.

upstreamMaterial.adaptations: None to the bitmap. CSS layers darken the grain, select background positions and add carved/bevelled edges; no new raster or model generation.
upstreamMaterial.rightsStatus: Upstream game/art license not declared; user-directed project reuse; unresolved rights retained. Existing city manifest preserves the AFT ancestry.

components.retained: Live hero strip and battle-bottom > thumb-layout > left-controls / stick-column / right-controls composition.
components.adaptations: Tinderbox health and five-tool rack, three drug buttons on left, raw movement stick centrally, primary/Pause on right. Compact desktop rack sits alongside the complete thumb layout. No AP, End Turn, stance or campaign semantics.

components.retained: Three-column thumb layout, vertical action banks, rounded-square well, circular ring, cross axes, north mark, knob and caption; 155/112/65px base geometry; 160px desktop and 138/100/59px small-screen geometry.
components.adaptations: Selectors scoped to .tb-ui and per-mount classes instead of shared #battle/#joystick/#stick-knob IDs. Small-screen geometry applies to phones up to 650px; button targets remain >=44px. Travel uses existing normalized raw input. Surface treatment is separate in wood.css.

components.retained: Square industrial switches with icon/label/count legend grouped as one material state.
components.adaptations: Tinderbox button dimensions and legends use the source hardware structure; CSS-only wood material replaces metal. Selected/active controls have a bright outline and lower inlay. Empty/disabled counts remain explicit. No alert animation imported.

components.retained: Existing byte-preserved imported stylesheet supplies legend grouping, focus, pressed/lit/disabled and reduced-motion behavior.
components.adaptations: Wood material overrides both atlas layers with the reused timber and CSS borders; no vendor bytes edited. Source switch states and accessibility are retained; illumination is an inlay rather than a glowing lens.

implementation.commandBoundary: mountUI({root,onCommand}) -> {update,dispose}; existing command and snapshot v1 unchanged; no gameplay/aim/inversion rules added.
